page_title: LEE 1-0 EVE | Leeds v Everton 18/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+7' Michael Keane (Everton) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. It's a free kick to Leeds, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
90+6' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle and it's Beto (Everton) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Leeds are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
90+4' The game has come to an end for Ao Tanaka. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Sean Longstaff (Leeds).

90+2' Anton Stach (Leeds) is first to react to a great cross from Brenden Aaronson, but slices his shot high over the bar from inside the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.

90+1' A neat pass is well received by Anton Stach (Leeds), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
90+1' Jack Harrison (Leeds) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
86' Today's match ends for Carlos Alcaraz who will be replaced by Thierno Barry (Everton).
84' 1 - 0 Goal! Lukas Nmecha (Leeds) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of Jordan Pickford.
84' Lukas Nmecha (Leeds) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
84' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
83' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Everton, he's going to review using VAR.
82' James Tarkowski (Everton) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. Leeds are awarded a penalty. What an opportunity to score!
82' What a great touch by Lukas Nmecha (Leeds) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
80' Ao Tanaka (Leeds) releases a superb dipping volley at goal from the edge of the box that flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
80' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
78' The substitution is prepared. Ilia Gruev (Leeds) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ethan Ampadu.
78' That will be all from Daniel James who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jack Harrison (Leeds).
78' Daniel Farke has decided to make a change. Lukas Nmecha (Leeds) replaces Joel Piroe.

77' The corner kick picks out Jake O'Brien (Everton) free in the box, but his header from close in lacks control and balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leeds.
77' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Everton.

76' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Lucas Perri shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
76' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
75' Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Everton earn a free kick.
71' Here is a change. Tim Iroegbunam is going off and David Moyes gives the last tactical orders to Jack Grealish (Everton).
69' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by James Tarkowski (Everton). Chris Kavanagh saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Leeds in a dangerous position.
67' Substitution. Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) has come on for Wilfried Gnonto.
64' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Everton.
64' James Garner (Everton) decides to have a shot at goal from the free kick, but it hits the defensive wall. The linesman makes the right call and Everton will have a corner.
63' Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) gets a yellow card. The referee Chris Kavanagh made the right call.
60' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
60' Leeds take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
57' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
56' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) was quite harsh and Chris Kavanagh didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
56' A cross from Daniel James (Leeds) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball is out of play. Leeds win a corner kick.

55' Good chance! Wilfried Gnonto (Leeds) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.

54' A short pass finds Idrissa Gueye (Everton). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Leeds will have a goal kick.
50' Wilfried Gnonto (Leeds) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but Jordan Pickford is equal to it and makes an easy save.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' Chris Kavanagh has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

44' CLOSE! Wilfried Gnonto (Leeds) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that whistles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
39' Poor challenge! Joel Piroe (Leeds) is penalised for tripping and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle. Everton win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
37' Pascal Struijk (Leeds) gets to the ball swung in from the corner and plants a close-range header low towards goal, but it's blocked then cleared away.
37' Corner kick. Anton Stach (Leeds) is ready to send the ball into the box.
34' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is out of play. Everton will have a throw-in.

31' Ao Tanaka (Leeds) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
30' Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) is penalised for holding. Chris Kavanagh signals a set piece. Leeds have been awarded a free kick.
29' Lucas Perri displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
27' Daniel James (Leeds) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
25' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick to Leeds.
23' Wilfried Gnonto (Leeds) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
21' Joel Piroe (Leeds) gathers a nice lofted pass deep inside the box and attempts to put the ball into the middle of the goal, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players.

18' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Everton are awarded the free kick.
15' Leeds fail to score from a corner as Jordan Pickford (Everton) leaps to collect the ball.
14' A cross into the box from Wilfried Gnonto (Leeds) is cleared. The ball goes out of play. Leeds are awarded a corner kick.
14' Leeds can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
12' The corner is swung in but Leeds can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
12' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Wilfried Gnonto (Leeds), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Leeds force a corner. They send men into the box.
11' Leeds failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

10' Joel Piroe (Leeds) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Leeds will have a chance to score from a corner.
6' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
5' Leeds have been awarded a corner kick.

5' Joel Piroe (Leeds) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Jordan Pickford. The ball goes out for a corner. Leeds can continue in their attacking effort.
4' Flag goes up against Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Everton will kick-off.
Chris Kavanagh will supervise the game today.
